authority: Parent review messages in the LOC normalization task; approval history remains preserved.

supersedes.decision: Earlier temporary Elm/Haskell local let opening counted as a separate header.
supersedes.correction: A declaration-block let opening is structural zero. A let attached to one binding belongs to that binding and adds no duplicate header.

decisions.form: Proven named function with local let/in scope
decisions.example: f x = let a=1 in a+x
languages: haskell when an ownership pathway is qualified
decisions.gate: Only proven local declaration scope ownership; iteration/member/data in tokens remain structural.
Actual independent declarations/type headers retain their units.
Actual subprogram headers retain their units.

decisions.form: Proven call/data suffix after an executable callback close
decisions.gate: Real following expressions/calls or unproven suffix ownership require review.

decisions.form: Proven Smalltalk methodsFor/category-only file-in metadata delimiters
decisions.gate: Actual selector headers and written executable method closes retain one each; unknown bang ownership requires review.
Only proven reflective declaration field strings; arbitrary strings never become declarations.

decisions.form: Proven Smalltalk independent cascade message sends sharing a receiver
decisions.example: out nextPutAll: value; print: count; lf
decisions.gate: Argument-only composed messages/data stay one composition; unclear send ownership requires review.

decisions.form: Proven Smalltalk documentation-only comment chunk terminal bang
decisions.gate: Only exact comment-only chunk ownership; no blanket bang deletion.

decisions.form: Proven C/C++ typedef aggregate attached alias suffix
decisions.gate: Actual object declarations after an aggregate are separate bindings; unknown typedef/object suffix ownership remains reviewed.

decisions.form: Proven Pony recover with one construction/call result and no independent locals
decisions.gate: One value composition; unknown purity or ownership remains reviewed.

decisions.form: Proven Pony recover with independent local bindings
decisions.gate: Prove executable recover-region ownership before expanding.
Only proven constructor formals; separately written field/property declarations count and split normally.

decisions.form: Proven immediate Smalltalk unary callback invocation suffix
decisions.gate: Only the same immediately attached callback/control invocation; written header/body/close retain units, other sends/arguments/operators/subsequent statements remain reviewed.
Known annotation owner separate from attached function/declaration header; unknown annotation or macro/codegen ownership reviewed.

decisions.form: Proven Nim expression-only proc callback operand
decisions.gate: One composed call or binding only when no independent local definitions/statements; imperative callback header absorbs outer call/binding prefix, then body units count; owned call parenthesis0, no imputed close.

decisions.form: Pony outer binding containing imperative recover scope
decisions.example: let result = recover iso let x = Array[U8]; x end
decisions.gate: Standalone scope4; pure recover operand remains within one outer composition; unclear ownership reviewed.

A single call/member/index/operator/conditional composition irrespective of callee name/purity; independent bindings, sequencing, executable callbacks/control and malformed/unknown interpolation remain reviewed. Required-work/native-kernel eligibility is separate.
